soldier: Head reddish brown, pronotum brown, abdomen pale yellowish brown. Head capsule rectangular, the fontanelle pore large but not strongly raised. Anterior margin of the labrum straight. Mandibles rather slender and straight, the lacinia of the maxilla with 9 marginal bristles. Antennae 13–15-segmented, segment 1 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 twice segment 2. Anterior margin of the pronotum nearly straight with a shallow central incision, the posterior margin slightly concave at the middle, the lateral margins sloping steeply backwards, the midline faintly discernible.
